caption: You probably never noticed the bacteria that live on your nails. What do you think they might be doing there?
comments_seeded: I never thought about it, but now I'm curious - can nail bacteria affect our overall health?
Some people think keeping short nails can help reduce bacteria, but is that really the case?
How often do you clean under your nails, and do you think it makes a difference?
It's interesting to consider how our daily habits, like washing dishes or gardening, might impact the bacteria on our nails
What are some ways you take care of your nails to keep them healthy - do you have any favorite tips to share?
